profile.subtitleJa: ユダ王ヨシャファトの子。
profile.summaryJa: 列王記下1:17は、ヨシャファトの子ヨラムがユダの王として即位したと記します。
profile.identityNoteJa: この節では、ヨシャファトの子ヨラムをユダの王として記します。

facts.textJa: ヨラムは32歳で王となり、エルサレムで八年間治めたと記されます。
ヨラムは夜にエドム人を攻め、戦車隊長とともに包囲軍を打ちました。
ヨラムの他の事績はユダの王たちの記録にあるとされます。
ヨラムの死後、子アハズヤが王位を継いだと記されます。
ヨラムは、ユダの王たちが主の家にささげた物の一部をハザエルへ送りました。

wikipedia.noteJa: 英語版記事はユダの王ヨラムをイスラエルの同名王と区別し、「ヨラム」もその名の形として挙げています。

primaryWitnesses.textualBasisJa: So he died according to the LORD’s word which Elijah had spoken. Jehoram began to reign in his place in the second year of Jehoram the son of Jehoshaphat king of Judah, because he had no son.

Then Joram crossed over to Zair, and all his chariots with him; and he rose up by night and struck the Edomites who surrounded him with the captains of the chariots; and the people fled to their tents.
The rest of the acts of Joram, and all that he did, aren’t they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?
Joram slept with his fathers, and was buried with his fathers in David’s city; and Ahaziah his son reigned in his place.

But Jehosheba, the daughter of King Joram, sister of Ahaziah, took Joash the son of Ahaziah, and stole him away from among the king’s sons who were slain, even him and his nurse, and put them in the bedroom; and they hid him from Athaliah, so that he was not slain.

Jehoash king of Judah took all the holy things that Jehoshaphat and Jehoram and Ahaziah, his fathers, kings of Judah, had dedicated, and his own holy things, and all the gold that was found in the treasures of the LORD’s house, and of the king’s house, and sent it to Hazael king of Syria; and he went away from Jerusalem.
In the fifth year of Joram the son of Ahab king of Israel, Jehoshaphat being king of Judah then, Jehoram the son of Jehoshaphat king of Judah began to reign.
WEBはこの人物が32歳で王となり、エルサレムで8年間治めたと述べる。
primaryWitnesses.text: He was thirty-two years old when he began to reign. He reigned eight years in Jerusalem.
